reasoning: To secure crown-jewel data stores, we prioritize vulnerabilities present on internet-facing assets that are actively exploited (KEV). Remediating these exposed findings cuts off external attacker entry points. Internal findings without direct paths or non-KEV status are lower priority.

input.sql:
SELECT 
    f.id AS finding_id,
    a.id AS asset_id,
    a.hostname,
    v.cve,
    v.cvss,
    v.kev,
    ds.id AS datastore_id
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON e_of.dst = v.id
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.src = a.id AND e_reach.type = 'CAN_REACH'
JOIN datastores ds ON e_reach.dst = ds.id
WHERE ds.crown_jewel = true AND f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    f.id AS finding_id,
    a.id AS asset_id,
    a.hostname,
    v.cve,
    v.cvss,
    v.kev,
    ds.id AS datastore_id
FROM datastores ds
JOIN edges e_reach ON e_reach.dst = ds.id
JOIN assets a ON e_reach.src = a.id
JOIN edges e_runs ON e_runs.src = a.id AND e_runs.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software sw ON e_runs.dst = sw.id
JOIN edges e_has ON e_has.src = sw.id AND e_has.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON e_has.dst = v.id
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.dst = v.id
JOIN findings f ON e_of.src = f.id
WHERE ds.crown_jewel = true AND f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    f.id AS finding_id,
    a.hostname,
    v.cve,
    v.cvss,
    v.kev,
    e.type AS edge_type,
    e.props
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON o.dst = v.id
JOIN edges n ON n.src = f.id AND n.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON n.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e ON (e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    f.id AS finding_id,
    a.hostname,
    v.cve,
    v.cvss,
    v.kev
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e_ex ON e_ex.dst = a.id AND e_ex.type = 'EXPOSES'
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON e_of.dst = v.id
WHERE f.status = 'open'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    f.id AS finding_id,
    a.hostname,
    v.cve,
    v.cvss,
    v.kev
FROM findings f
JOIN edges e_on ON e_on.src = f.id AND e_on.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON e_on.dst = a.id
JOIN edges e_ex ON e_ex.dst = a.id AND e_ex.type = 'EXPOSES'
JOIN edges e_of ON e_of.src = f.id AND e_of.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON e_of.dst = v.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;
